user: For that original charge, state its applicable filing window in days and the exact filing deadline. Do I still have time? Do not file anything.
answer:
The filing window for **goods not received** is **90 days from the transaction date**. Both TechMart Online charges are still within it, as of today (15 September 2026):

- **TX-0402** (14 July 2026, EUR 240.00): deadline **12 October 2026**, 27 days remaining.
- **TX-0401** (20 July 2026, EUR 240.00): deadline **18 October 2026**, 33 days remaining.

I haven't confirmed which charge is the one that never arrived, so I can't say which deadline applies to your case. Please tell me which transaction it is. I'll then run the eligibility check, and I won't file anything unless you ask me to. I'd recommend doing this well before the earlier deadline.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Limit operations
## Window definition
Limits are tracked on calendar days, not business days. The daily window runs
from 00:00 to 23:59 CET.

Glossary
## Chargeback window
The number of days, counted from the transaction date, during which a dispute
may be raised under a given reason code.

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.
